test_title: PYST 15: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On 15 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹3000 as a sum borrowed at 8% per year rate of interest for 6 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹3000

Rate of Interest (R) = 8% per year

Time (T) = 6 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

SI = (₹3000 × 8 × 6) / 100

⇒ SI = (₹144000) / 100

⇒ SI = ₹1440

**The simple interest on ₹3000 at 8% per year for 6 years is ₹1440.**
